integrity: Deterministic standalone reconstruction of face enumeration, acyclic matching, integral cellular differential and all 120 symmetry traces. All file hashes and byte lengths are carried by the enclosing entry.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the ordinary matching complex of the Petersen graph; rational symmetry representations only; no equivariant wedge splitting or larger-family theorem; finite certificate is independently re-runnable but not externally audited.
title: Integral homotopy and the \(S_5\)-character of the Petersen edge-matching complex
